conceptZh: 兩隻手臂長短不一的玩具機器人數著從邊緣探頭的小方塊，橫線先躲再出現，「白」跟著探頭，最後湊滿一百顆貼紙。
object: a boxy toy robot built from mismatched parts with one long arm and one short arm, and a pile of stickers numbered up to one hundred
morph: a bar slides in from the edge and hides, the 白 below peeks in and dodges, and then both settle as 百
creativeAngle: 躲貓貓：上面那一橫和下面的「白」輪流從畫面邊緣探頭又躲開，機器人長手臂抓不到、短手臂又搆不到，最後一百顆星星貼紙湊齊。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy with a locked frontal camera, bright and cheerful, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale-lemon backdrop with a soft light-gray floor line. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated cobalt-blue Traditional Chinese glyph 百, a horizontal bar on top of the 白 component, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with margins. The lead is an original boxy toy robot made of mismatched parts, in brick-red and mustard, with one noticeably long arm and one stubby arm and a bendy antenna; no real people. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the robot trundles in rubbing its antenna, a thick blue horizontal bar slides in from the top-left edge and the robot swipes at it with his long arm, but it ducks away off-screen; the first spoken 百 lands as the bar peeks back in and the robot spins around. Moment two (1.8-3.4s): the blue 白 shape pops up from the bottom edge like a periscope, the robot reaches with the short arm and cannot reach, so he stretches the long arm, which flops over his own head; the second spoken 百 lands as the 白 dodges to the side and then slides into place center under the returning bar. Moment three (3.4-5.0s): the bar drops onto the 白 with a firm click, forming 百, and the robot's chest door pops open spilling numbered star stickers that fly up in a neat grid and tick-tick-tick count themselves, while the word 一百 is spoken as the last sticker slaps onto the robot's forehead. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 百 is completely still, unobstructed and crisp in cobalt blue; the robot stands at the far side, long arm raised in a proud wave while the short arm flaps in time and his antenna bobs, never touching the strokes. Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「百、百、一百」, read as ㄅㄞˇ、ㄅㄞˇ、ㄧˋ ㄅㄞˇ, first utterance at about 0.6s, second at about 2.7s, the word at about 4.4s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. Only soft ticks and a gentle chime under the voice, no background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter.
